answer:
Implemented `GET /api/customers/search?q=...`.

- Case-insensitive name/email matching
- Trims and validates queries of at least 2 characters
- Admins see tenant customers; support sees assigned customers only
- Results sorted by name and limited to `id`, `name`, `email`
- Added authorization and validation tests

`mvn -o -q test` passed.
